results.instruction: Place the two halves of the mouse casing on a flat surface.
Align the internal components with the bottom half of the mouse casing.
Carefully place the top half of the mouse casing over the internal components.
Press down firmly to secure the top half onto the bottom half of the mouse casing.
Ensure all edges are properly aligned and snapped into place.
Inspect the mouse to confirm that the casing is securely closed.
Gently press along the seams to check for any gaps or loose parts.
Verify that the mouse functions correctly by testing its buttons and scroll wheel.
If necessary, adjust the casing to ensure a snug fit.
Once satisfied, set the reassembled mouse aside.
Clean any tools or debris from the workspace.
Store the mouse in a safe location for future use.
